name: live.dream11app/releases
title: Dream11 App Android Releases
description: Look up current and retained Dream11 App APKs with exact file sizes, SHA-256 and release links.

tools.name: get_current_android_release
tools.description: Look up current Full or Lite APK metadata from dream11app.live: version, package, exact bytes, SHA-256 and first-party links. Does not download or install anything.

variant.description: Omit to include both Full and Lite.

tools.name: list_retained_android_releases
tools.description: List APKs retained by dream11app.live. Filter by exact version and/or Full or Lite. Returns not_retained for no match and unavailable if the catalog cannot be read. No third-party releases or substitutions.

variant.description: Omit to include both Full and Lite.

version.description: Exact release version such as 3.11.0; omit to list retained versions.
